title: Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt (and the milk if using), and whisk until the yolks and whites are fully combined.
Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in the eggs. Let them sit for a few seconds, then gently push them around the pan with a spatula, forming soft curds.
Cook 3-4 minutes, stirring gently, until just set but still soft and glossy. Add the cheese in the last minute if using.
Season with black pepper and serve right away.
notes: Everyday staple. Pareve as written (oil, no cheese) — adding cheese makes it dairy.
